title: Elemental Swords & Others!
description: This mod adds multiple swords. Most shoot projectiles that either explode shoot a laser or both.
body:
This mod adds seven elemental swords (and non elemental swords) The lightning sword, the nature sword, the water sword, the fire sword, the tnt sword, and the void sword. All of witch shoot projectiles that expload and sometimes other things. Keep in mind that some swords have a left-click ability. And make sure to check out my other [mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/fever-dream!)

Note:

Contant creators may use this mod as long as they state the name of the mod and where to find it.
